title: I Didn't Mean to Yell
subtitle: A Gentle Guide for Moms Who Love Their Kids Fiercely and Lose Their Temper Anyway: Calmer Days, Kinder Words and the Repair That Heals
cover_sub: For every mom who loves fiercely and snaps anyway
author: Clara Whitfield
back: "Why do I keep yelling at the people I love most?"|If you've asked yourself that at 9 p.m., after the house finally went quiet, you are not a bad mother. You are a tired one, carrying more than one nervous system can hold.|This warm, shame-free guide shows you why loving moms snap, how to pause in the three seconds before the yell, what to say in the hardest moments (mornings, bedtime, sibling fights, screens), and how to repair afterwards so your child feels safe again.|Imagine a bedtime where you're the calm one. Start with two breaths tonight.
